acceptance_criteria.criterion: renderChunksToStructured() is exported from chunk-renderer.ts and returns a DialogueBlock[] array for valid JSONL input.
The DialogueBlock type is a discriminated union with four variants: text, tool-call (with optional result field), subagent-heading, and checklist.
AI text content is emitted as { type: 'text' } blocks with no JSON or tool call data mixed in.
Tool calls are emitted as { type: 'tool-call' } blocks containing the tool name, detail lines from the existing getToolDetailLines() dispatcher, and the parsed args object.
ToolMessage results for non-inline tools (not execute/task) are embedded as result: { content: string } within the corresponding tool-call block.
write_todos tool calls produce { type: 'checklist' } blocks instead of generic tool-call blocks.
Subagent messages produce a { type: 'subagent-heading' } block preceding the subagent's content blocks.
buildFullToolResultIndex() indexes results for ALL ToolMessage entries regardless of tool name.
All existing renderChunksToDialogue() and renderChunksToMarkdown() tests continue to pass unchanged.
